title: Official F1® Arcade Austin Watch Party
description:
Experience all the race day energy at F1® Arcade.

TIMINGS:

Venue opens: 10am (get in early to soak up the atmosphere)

  • Watch Party starts: 7pm
  • Race starts: 8pm
  • Open sim racing: 7pm - 10pm

GENERAL ADMISSION

Your ticket includes open sim racing from one hour before lights out until the end of the Watch Party. Between the race action, jump into the driver’s seat for head-to-head battles on track, and take on our complimentary mini-games, including React and Lights Out.

Enjoy a DJ throughout the day and a live host during the Watch Party, plus quizzes and competitions, including our fastest-lap challenge to keep the energy high from start to finish.

After each sim race, please be considerate of other guests to ensure everyone gets a chance to race.

PLEASE NOTE SEATING IS NOT GUARANTEED AND IS ON A FIRST COME FIRST SERVED BASIS.

CLUB ENCLOSURE 

Upgrade your Watch Party experience with our Club Enclosure ticket, our exclusive, semi-private area where you’ll be the centre of the action in premium seats.

What’s included:

Allocated seat in our exclusive Club Enclosure area

Selection of sharers and a choice of main; Chicken, Beef or Plant Burger, or Caesar/Superbowl Salad 4 House Drinks (House Beer, Wine, Mocktails, Soft Drinks).
address: F1 Arcade Birmingham, 2 Chamberlain Square, Birmingham, B3 3AX

title: Sprint Social: Halloween Edition
description:
Zero chill, 100% thrill.

Don't forget, the spookiest night on the F1® Arcade calendar is almost here.

On 30th October, Sprint Social goes Halloween in London and Birmingham. Fancy dress is encouraged, and the best costume wins a prize.

Three hours of racing, food, drinks and competition. Warm up on free-play, then go head-to-head in a hosted team tournament. Top drivers battle it out in the finale before the sims reopen for one last free-play race.

TIMINGS

Check-in with reception by 5:45pm.

Tournament starts 6pm

WHAT'S INCLUDED

  • £25 per person.
  • Welcome drink: Heineken® or Heineken® 0.0 or soft drinks.
  • Sharing-style flatbreads (GF & vegan on request).
  • Free-play racing before and after the tournament.
  • Halloween Costume Content with prizes
  • 90-minute hosted tournament.
  • All guests must be 18+

FROM ROOKIE TO ELITE

Five skill levels, one grid. Come to compete, come for the social side however you race, there's a place for you.

Sprint Social T&C
address: F1 Arcade Birmingham, 2 Chamberlain Square, Birmingham, B3 3AX

title: F1® Arcade Network Event
description:
Looking to take your networking to the fast lane? F1 Arcade Birmingham has you covered with our first networking event.

Join guests from businesses in the Midlands for an evening of racing and networking.

What’s included:

  • Welcome Drink
  • Nibbles
  • Open sim racing 5pm – 7pm
  • Networking opportunities

T&C

Tickets are £20 + booking fee.

This is a private networking event and all guests must be registered in advance.

The event is for business and networking purposes — all attendees must be over 18.

Tickets includes a Welcome Drink, Unlimited Racing for the event duration, and Sharing Nibbles.

Welcome Drink choices are a glass of Prosecco, bottle of Beer or Soft Drink.

Ticket includes unlimited sim racing. Jump in the driver’s seat between laps for some head-to-head fun and test your skills on the track. After each sim race, please be mindful of other guests to ensure everyone gets a chance to race.

Photos and videos may be taken during the event and used for promotional purposes. By attending, you give consent to be included in this content. If you’d prefer not to appear, please let a member of the team know on arrival.

Booking Policy applies - https://f1arcade.com/uk/booking-policy

Additional FAQs can be found here: https://f1arcade.com/uk/faqs.
address: F1 Arcade Birmingham, 2 Chamberlain Square, Birmingham, B3 3AX

title: Shared Christmas Party
description:
Join one of F1® Arcade's Shared Christmas Parties in Birmingham and celebrate the festive season with teams from across your city. Whether you're rewarding colleagues, entertaining clients, or simply looking for an unforgettable Christmas night out, we've got the perfect mix of racing, food, drinks and festive atmosphere.

Start the celebrations with a glass of fizz on arrival before taking on our high-energy Tournament experience. Compete across our state-of-the-art racing simulators, battle for bragging rights, and enjoy all the drama of Formula 1® in a fun, social setting.

Your ticket includes:

  • Glass of fizz on arrival
  • 2 hours of bottomless drinks
  • Selection of festive food and flatbreads
  • Hosted Tournament racing experience
  • Dedicated event host
  • Christmas party atmosphere

Perfect for smaller teams that want the excitement of an F1® Arcade Christmas party without booking a private event.

Spaces are limited: gather your team, choose your date, and get ready to race into the festive season.

Over 18 only.
address: F1 Arcade Birmingham, 2 Chamberlain Square, Birmingham, B3 3AX
